name: Ghosted Fates
source:
Trapped in a manor where the worlds of the living and the dead intertwine, you discover that love is your only hope of survival.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你被困在一座阴阳两界交织的庄园里，才发现爱情是自己活下去的唯一希望。
